mainEntity.name: How do I know if my cabin actually needs interior sealing or if I'm overthinking it?

acceptedAnswer.text: You are usually eligible if the interior has visible gaps, drafts, or air movement between conditioned rooms and unconditioned spaces. Interior sealing is especially useful when you want to reduce drafts, improve comfort, or prepare a cabin for seasonal temperature swings in places like Centennial, Parker, or Greenwood Village.
acceptedAnswer.description: If you feel drafts, see daylight at joints, or notice temperature swings between rooms, sealing is likely worthwhile. Cabins with older trim, settling gaps, or exposed utility penetrations are common candidates.
